explication: PortaPack Mayhem is firmware for the HackRF/PortaPack device. Its user-facing product is a collection of built-in and external applications, including radio receive/transmit tools, analysis utilities, and general-purpose apps. The tree also shows shared UI/navigation, radio-clock, I²C-device, and baseband-processing layers. The excerpts do not show the top-level boot path or most app-to-radio execution, so the graph keeps those connections conservative; listed app families reflect the repository tree rather than inspected implementations.
